scope: Exact Cargo feature inventory for pinned upstream releases. Flags that bundle capabilities or change implementation are classified separately from missing user capabilities. This is not complete parity proof.

async.airbug: Core Executor and async builders are available without an optional runtime; tests/executors.rs and tests/measurements.rs.

async_tokio.airbug: async-tokio / Runtime and Handle adapters; tests/executors.rs.

cargo_bench_support.airbug: No source reference to this feature in the pinned Criterion src tree. Airbug Cargo harness behavior is checked by test-cargo-test-benches.py and test-cargo-bench.py.

csv_output.airbug: Raw report CSV and saved machine-formatted custom CSV are built in. See artifacts.json; no matching Cargo feature name required.

default.airbug: Airbug defaults to macros and parallel-analysis; individual capabilities are mapped separately.

html_reports.airbug: No source reference to this feature in the pinned Criterion src tree. Built-in HTML/SVG and --no-html control Airbug artifact generation; visual audit remains open.

plotters.airbug: Built-in SVG instead of selectable Plotters/Gnuplot. Plot families tracked in plots.json; backend format/capability and visual audit remain open.

rayon.airbug: Default parallel-analysis feature covers descriptive, regression, relative and pooled-null hypothesis bootstrap plus Gaussian KDE. Tests preserve sequential RNG/order, non-Send transform callbacks and every density coordinate; see parallel-analysis.json for policies and measured examples. Scoped OS threads are independent of benchmark workers and Rayon. This does not prove every upstream scheduling/performance behavior or all platforms.

real_blackbox.airbug: No source reference to this feature in the pinned Criterion src tree. Airbug reexports std::hint::black_box and implements black_box_drop; tests/contracts.rs.

stable.airbug: Enables CSV, HTML and three async adapters in Criterion; native capabilities mapped individually, spelling compatibility is outside user requirements.

default.airbug: Enables wrap_help upstream; Airbug help is built in.

dyn_thread_local.airbug: Divan switches away from its reserved macOS x86_64 TLS slot to pthread TLS. Airbug allocation tracking uses standard thread_local! with try_with; no reserved TLS slot. tests/thread_allocations.rs checks worker isolation and cross-thread frees. Does not establish identical tracking overhead.

help.airbug: Built-in --help and --help-all; no optional help dependency gate.

internal_benches.airbug: Adds Divan self-benchmarks in alloc/time/thread_pool modules. Not a consumer benchmarking capability or required compatibility API.

wrap_help.airbug: --help/--help-all detect terminal width; COLUMNS overrides, fallback 80. Word wrapping preserves commands, option tokens and paths. Help returns before benchmark registration/environment parsing. Two unit tests and test-help.py passed: 24 width/entrypoint combinations plus actual POSIX PTY width 40 on macOS. Windows runtime terminal detection remains unverified.
